subject: Dedicated capacity: workload profile, pool sizing proposal & pricing
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ko <alex@nimedge.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity: workload profile, pool sizing proposal & pricing

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the time on Friday. To get you a concrete Dedicated proposal (pool sizing + pricing + commit tiers) we need a short workload profile from your side so we can map to GPU throughput and a recommended reserved commit. Can you confirm the numbers below (or paste your telemetry):

- Average requests per minute (RPS or RPM) and expected peak window (minutes)
- Typical prompt/context length (tokens) and average generated tokens per request
- Concurrent active sessions during peak (approximate)
- Latency expectation (95th/99th) and availability SLO target
- Any heavy tails (e.g., occasional 8k-16k contexts vs normal 1k) or multimodal workloads

We can then propose a GPU pool (type & count), expected tokens/sec throughput, target concurrency, and a recommended reserved commit level (monthly). I've attached a short pricing worksheet and included an example workload CSV — fill that in if easier.

Goal: deliver a sizing recommendation and two pricing options (12mo commit with discount, and a flexible 3mo pilot commit).

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity: workload profile, pool sizing proposal & pricing

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks — please see our current numbers below (exported from our staging traces):

- Typical steady: ~300 reqs/min (5 reqs/sec). Peak windows: 10–15 minutes, up to 1,000 reqs/min
- Prompt/context: mostly 1,024 tokens (few at 2,048). Average generated tokens ~220 tokens
- Concurrent active sessions during peak: ~55–70
- Latency target: 95th < 300ms; 99th < 500ms. We expect 99.9% availability
- Heavy tails: ~5% of requests hit 8k contexts (long-RAG queries)

I attached a simple CSV with sample traces. We're trying to size conservatively but also keep costs reasonable.

Alex

Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity: workload profile, pool sizing proposal & pricing

Thanks for the numbers, Alex — Dylan from the infra team here. I ran a quick capacity model against those traces and our microbenchmarks. Summary of the sizing logic and recommendation below: 

Sizing assumptions (conservative):
- Model: open Llama-style ~34B (production-config, fp16/quantized path)
- Tokens/sec per A100-equivalent: ~22k tokens/sec steady-state (short sequences); long contexts decrease batching efficiency
- Average tokens per request (prompt + response): ~1,244 tokens (1,024 + 220)
- Effective requests/sec baseline: 5 rps steady, peaks up to ~16 rps during 1,000 rpm windows
- Target headroom for 95/99 latency SLOs: provision for 2.5x steady requests to absorb peaks and batching inefficiencies

Recommendation (two options):
1) Production reserved: 4 x A100-equivalent GPUs in a single pool (preferred)
   - Estimated sustained capacity: ~88k tokens/sec aggregate
   - Supports ~70–80 concurrent active sessions with 95/99 latency targets for normal 1k contexts and short tails
   - Handles short peak windows (1,000 rpm) with modest queuing; long-8k context requests will reduce effective throughput for short periods

2) Production + scale buffer: 6 x A100-equivalent GPUs (adds ~50% capacity)
   - Estimated sustained capacity: ~132k tokens/sec
   - Provides comfortable headroom for long-context bursts and keeps 99th percentile latency tighter during peaks

Commit guidance:
- 12-month reserved commit recommended for steady production: starting commit level equivalent to 4 GPUs (monthly committed spend).
- Pilot / flexible: 3-month reserved commit (discounted less) with autoscale burst to on-demand for short peaks.

Pricing headliner (ballpark for discussion):
- 4x pool (12mo commit): base list $110k/mo, available discount for 12mo commit: 12–18% depending on enterprise add-ons and terms
- 6x pool (12mo commit): base list $160k/mo, similar tiered discounting applies

I'll attach the capacity worksheet and a quick run-rate calc. Vanessa — happy for you to lead the commercial proposal.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Infra Eng, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Ko <alex@nimedge.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity: workload profile, pool sizing proposal & pricing

Vanessa / Dylan —

Thanks for the clear sizing. A few follow-ups from procurement/finance before we can commit: 

1) Can you offer a better discount for a 12-month commit if we can commit to the 6x pool (we prefer the extra headroom)? Our target blended price is ~$135k/month.
2) We need a throughput guarantee (tokens/sec) and a crediting mechanism if you miss latency/SLO targets during our monthly peak windows.
3) Overages: can you offer predictable overage billing (flat per-GPU rate) instead of variable on-demand prices?
4) If we start with a 3-month pilot for 4x and upgrade to 6x inside the first 90 days, will you credit the pilot months toward a 12mo commit?

Also, we have a couple of regulatory checkboxes: SOC2 evidence and support for customer-managed KMS in Private deployments. We can run the POC in a VPC but want the long-term private key control.

Alex
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ko <alex@nimedge.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity: workload profile, pool sizing proposal & pricing

Alex — thanks for the clear asks. Quick responses and a commercial counter we can put in a short-term proposal/term sheet: 

1) Discount for 6x / 12mo: we can offer a 15% enterprise discount off list for a 12-month reserved commit at the 6x pool level (list $160k/mo -> $136k/mo). That gets within your $135k target with a small additional rebate tied to usage thresholds (if you commit to a 90% utilization target we can structure a $1k/mo rebate for months that exceed 92% utilization).

2) Throughput SLA & credits: we will commit to an aggregate tokens/sec floor per pool (documented in the term sheet) and provide credits for missed monthly availability/latency SLOs. Typical crediting: 10% service credit for a single month if monthly 99th latency exceeds the agreed threshold by >15%. We can finalize the exact numbers in the SLA section.

3) Overage pricing: yes — we will provide a flat monthly per-GPU overage rate for burst capacity rather than variable on-demand pricing. We'll specify the per-GPU overage at a known rate (e.g., $X per additional A100-equivalent GPU-hour) and cap overage billing at a monthly percentage of the commit unless you opt into unlimited bursts.

4) Pilot crediting: if you sign a 3-month pilot (4x) and convert to 12mo for 6x within 90 days, we will credit up to 2 of the pilot months against the annual billing (pro-rated).

Security/regulatory: we support customer-managed KMS for Private deployments and can provide SOC 2 Type II evidence packages during contract negotation.

Next step: Vanessa will share a short term sheet with the pricing options (4x pilot + 6x 12mo commit with the 15% discount and credit terms). We'd like to schedule a legal/pricing sync next week to get to signatures.
